protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: at the fix parent, bgp_attr_encap() accepts an attacker-controlled VNC sub-TLV length that fits the remaining UPDATE and stores exactly that many bytes; rfapiRibBi2Ri() later reads value[0] and value[1] and allocates/copies length-2 without first requiring length >= 3. Length 0 or 1 therefore causes out-of-bounds reads and a negative int converted to a huge allocation size, while length 2 with inner length zero is also invalid. The function is reached from the RFAPI RIB update/preload paths, and configure.ac enables BGP VNC unless explicitly disabled. CVE.org independently reports CVE-2026-37460 as PUBLISHED, and GHSA-4ph9-3c4q-r2hh has withdrawn_at=null.
